_note: Skills built into Claude Code (no files on disk). One line each: what it's for.
dataviz: Design any chart, graph, dashboard, KPI tile or data visualization, in any medium.
artifact-design: Design rules to load before writing an HTML Artifact page (claude.ai published page).
artifact-diagramming: Draw diagrams inside an Artifact page with inline SVG.
artifact-capabilities: Give an Artifact page runtime features: shared data, forms, uploads, live data, asking Claude.
update-config: Change Claude Code settings.json: hooks, permissions, env vars, automatic 'whenever X do Y' behaviors.
keybindings-help: Customize Claude Code keyboard shortcuts in keybindings.json.
code-review: Review the current diff, branch or PR for bugs at a chosen effort level; optionally post or fix.
simplify: Clean up recently changed code for reuse, simplicity and efficiency (quality only, not bug hunting).
fewer-permission-prompts: Scan past sessions and add an allowlist so Claude Code asks for permission less often.
loop: Run a prompt or slash command repeatedly on an interval, e.g. check a deploy every 5 minutes.
schedule: Create or manage scheduled cloud agents that run on a cron schedule or once at a set time.
claude-api: Build with the Claude API / Anthropic SDK: model IDs, pricing, tool use, caching, agents.
workflow-authoring: Write a multi-agent Workflow script (only when a workflow was explicitly requested).
claude-in-chrome: Drive the Chrome browser: click, fill forms, read pages, screenshots, console logs.
run: Launch this project's app to see a change working, take a screenshot or confirm it runs.
init: Create a CLAUDE.md file describing the current codebase.
security-review: Security review of the pending changes on the current branch.
